 For the Petitioner : Mr. Devesh Ajmani, Advocate
 For the State : Mrs. Anuradha Sahay, App
For the Informant : Mr. Ritesh Kumar, Advocate ......
04/ 13.09.2024.

Apprehending his arrest, petitioner above-named has moved this Court for grant of
anticipatory bail in connection with Olidih (Mango) [Jamshedpur] P.S. Case No.53 of 2024
registered under Sections 376 / 323/ 506 of the Indian Penal Code.
Heard the parties.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the victim is a major lady aged about 33 years and there is inordinate delay in lodging the FIR.
It is submitted that as per the FIR, the incidence took place on 19.12.2023 and the FIR has been lodged on 20.02.2024.
Further consensual physical relationship took place on a false promise of marriage several times which will not make out an offence of rape.
Learned APP for the State assisted by learned counsel for the informant has vehemently opposed the prayer.
It is submitted that the first incidence took place without consent of the informant.
Considering the submissions of learned counsel and the fact as discussed above, the anticipatory bail application is allowed.

Hence, in the event of his arrest or surrender within a period of three weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order before the learned court below, the petitioner named above shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Court below,
subject to the conditions laid down under Section 438(2) Cr. P.C.
The petitioner will co-operate in the investigation and will appear on notice under Section 41 A of Cr.P.C. as and when his presence is Abhishek @ Abhishek Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand.
